definition: evidence gap: retrieval returned no relevant snippet, so most answers are Unverified
claim nuance beyond six counts (partly true, cherry-picking, flawed inference)
answerer misreads or mismatches the snippet (entity, number, date)
classifier verdict contradicts clear counts (state Supports/Refutes, verdict the other)
decomposition: questions off-topic or no question tests the false part
answerer conservative: a relevant snippet was retrieved but the answer is Unverified
gold label hard to defend or not checkable from evidence
question polarity or negation breaks the Yes/No-to-support mapping
